svg.text: The move, step by step (customer and driver side by side)

g.text: Step 1 · Customer: waiting for a driver (before)
Step 4 · Driver: start heading to the pickup
Step 5 · Customer: driver on the way (live map)
Step 6 · Driver: on the way, sharing location
Step 7 · Customer: pay the 50% down payment
Step 8 · Driver: confirm the down payment
Step 10 · Driver: load and describe the cargo
Step 12 · Driver: enter the Start PIN
Step 13 · Driver: PIN verified, check the plate
Step 14 · Driver: cargo checklist and confirmation
Step 15 · Customer: review and confirm the cargo
Step 20 · Driver: confirm delivery with the PIN
Step 21 · Customer: delivered, final payment due
Step 22 · Driver: collect the final payment
Step 23 · Customer: completed, rate the driver
Step 25 · Driver: earnings and weekly remittance
